model.documentation:
ArchiSurance Case Study - Linked.Archi edition (3.1.0-la.1).
A maintained derivative of "ArchiSurance Case Study, Version 3.1, ArchiMate Model Exchange File Format" by Henk Jonkers, Iver Band, Dick Quartel and Marc Lankhorst, (c) 2012-2019 The Open Group, published as document Y194 (https://publications.opengroup.org/y194) under CC BY-SA 3.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/).
The ArchiSurance Case Study is a fictitious example developed to illustrate the use of the ArchiMate(R) modeling language in the context of the TOGAF(R) framework.
Changes by Linked.Archi (see CHANGES.md): empty multilingual placeholders removed; global identifiers (property "@id") and architecture state (property "arch:architectureState") added; metadata added. Identifiers of elements, relationships and views are unchanged.
This edition is licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/). ArchiMate(R) and TOGAF(R) are registered trademarks of The Open Group.
